cc:Work.dc:title: Observed TLS certificate lifetimes
cc:Work.dc:description: Observed TLS certificate lifetimes. 47 days or less: 8 of 712 (1.1%); 48–100 days: 289 of 712 (40.6%); 101–200 days: 248 of 712 (34.8%); 201–398 days: 165 of 712 (23.2%); Over 398 days: 2 of 712 (0.3%). One vantage point on 18 Sep 2026. No certificate observed for 288 domains; not an internet-wide estimate.
